flags.why: This usage denotes the colonial police station or office, rather than the police force ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/C%E1%BA%A9m)).
The common meaning of diminishing or losing some quantity is missing ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Hao)).
flags.fix: to diminish; to decrease through loss — Nước trong bình hao đi một ít. = The water in the container has decreased a little.

flags.why: The ordinary sense expresses an undesirable condition lasting to the end of one's life, rather than naming misery or fate ([dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/mat-kiep-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
flags.fix: for the rest of one's life (of an undesirable condition)

flags.why: This sense is a curse meaning despicable or contemptible, rather than merely unhappy or impoverished ([dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/mat-kiep-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
The curse sense needs an offensive warning so learners do not mistake it for a neutral description ([dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/mat-kiep-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
The example explains what people called a psychiatric hospital instead of using the term to refer to one.
flags.fix: Ngày xưa, ông ấy từng bị đưa vào nhà thương điên. = In the old days, he was once sent to a lunatic asylum.

flags.why: The gloss identifies the term as insensitive, but its tags do not warn learners about its derogatory character.
The familiar negative sense describing someone as secretly scheming or sly is missing, which could make learners use it as praise ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/th%C3%A2m%20nho%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: adj [colloquial, derogatory] | sly; scheming — Thằng đó thâm nho lắm, đừng tin nó. = That guy is very scheming; don't trust him.
